title: Hereticon talk: flood myths rooted in real floods

tellings.quote: Was that behind the flood myths from all over the world there have been really there have been real floods that were really big really huge could be described as biblical in scale.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient catastrophes, describes a talk he gave at Hereticon, a gathering for unconventional ideas. His argument is that the flood myths found all over the world come from real floods, enormous ones that he says could be called biblical in scale, likely from ice melting at the end of the last Ice Age. If so, ancient legends would be memories of actual events.
